plants.name: Lavandula angustifolia
plants.description: Rolling purple rows of lavender stripe the sun-baked plateaus of Provence. Slender spikes of tiny violet flowers rise above silvery-green foliage. The air hums with bees and carries a sweet, herbal perfume.
plants.bloomingSeason: Mid-June to late August, with peak bloom in July
plants.funFact: The name lavender comes from the Latin 'lavare', meaning 'to wash'. Romans scented their baths with it.

plants.name: Protea cynaroides
plants.description: The king protea is the largest of all proteas. Its dinner-plate-sized flower heads have a crown of silky, pink-tipped bracts around a downy center. In the cool, wet southern winter it lights up the fynbos of the Cape.
plants.bloomingSeason: Winter and spring, roughly June to October
plants.funFact: It is South Africa's national flower. It is adapted to fire-prone fynbos, and its thick underground stems can resprout after a blaze.
